meta.head: 4406c5602b
meta.rules: every entry is a single read-only statement; no CTE writing, no DDL/DML; :param placeholders are NOT allowed — inline literal sample values instead
meta.runnerContract: Execute each queries[].sql verbatim against the restored database. PASS = the statement finishes without a PostgreSQL error and the result column count matches expect; rows == 0 is a PASS unless expect says otherwise. FAIL = any error. No SQL in this file contains a double-quoted identifier, so psql -c "<sql>" survives shell quoting for every entry.
meta.derivation: Every entry is traced to a real call site recorded in `source`. Drizzle-built queries are reproduced as the SQL `.toSQL()` would emit: table-qualified identifiers flattened, camelCase result aliases rewritten to snake_case, and `db.select()` (no argument list) expanded to the full column list because that is literally what the ORM sends. Where a call site filters by the authenticated userId, the fixture supplies that id with a limit-based subquery instead of a magic id, so the statement stays valid on an empty or partially restored database.
notes: Credential-bearing columns ARE included where the real call site selects them (users.two_factor_secret bytea, user_auth_info.id_card encrypted text, user_third_party_accounts.access_token/refresh_token, im_adapters.credentials_json) — omitting them would make the fixture lie about the SQL it claims to replay, and a restore that silently drops a column is exactly the defect being hunted. Drill runners must therefore report column counts and errors only, never row values.

ai_model_config.api_key_enc is NOT covered: no production read selects it (relay-key-pool reads other columns), so there is no call site to derive a query from. Same for the payments table — apps/api writes to payments but has no read call site at all, so no query here references it.

plans.interval is a PostgreSQL keyword-shaped column name that the app only ever reaches through Drizzle's quoted identifier. Since this fixture forbids double-quoted identifiers, it is excluded from the plans-adjacent projections and is recorded as a coverage gap rather than faked.

publish_tasks / publish_history are read by apps/ai-service (asyncpg raw SQL), not by apps/api — apps/api forwards over HTTP. Their `source` values are therefore Python file:line, which is where the real call site lives.

search_vector on users / projects / files is created only by hand-written migration 0010 and is declared in no Drizzle table, so it appears in no drizzle-kit snapshot. The three full-text entries here are the only thing in this fixture that can tell a migration-replay restore apart from a schema-push restore.

queries.covers: 登录态取用户主记录 — db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.id, id)).limit(1)。Drizzle 把无参 select() 展开为全部列,所以这条投影就是整个 users 行形的还原检查,含 bytea 的 2FA 密文与 jsonb 备份码数组
queries.sql: SELECT id, phone, email, username, password_hash, nickname, avatar, bio, gender, birthday, family_id, role_id, dept_id, status, is_vip, identity_type, level, is_system_admin, invite_code, parent_id, created_at, updated_at, two_factor_secret, two_factor_enabled, two_factor_backup_codes, two_factor_enabled_at FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 5

queries.covers: 账号密码登录取用户 — username / phone / email 三选一 OR 谓词。字面量是探针值,不必存在,0 行即 PASS
queries.sql: SELECT id, username, phone, email, password_hash, status, is_vip, role_id, identity_type FROM users WHERE username = 'restore-drill-probe' OR phone = 'restore-drill-probe' OR email = 'restore-drill-probe' LIMIT 1

queries.covers: 全站用户搜索主路径 — search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery(...) OR phone ILIKE。还原敏感面:tsvector 列只由手写迁移 0010 建立、不在 Drizzle schema 也不在任何 drizzle-kit 快照里;ILIKE 的大小写折叠依赖 lc_ctype
queries.sql: SELECT id, nickname, email, phone, avatar FROM users WHERE search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery('pg_catalog.simple', 'zhang') OR phone ILIKE '%138%' LIMIT 20
queries.expect: no error; column count 5. 报 42703 column does not exist 或 42883 operator does not exist 即全文层未随库还原 —— 注意本调用点带 catch 降级到 ILIKE,所以它在应用侧是静默的,只有这里会响

queries.covers: SSO 统一登出前的活跃令牌集合 — user_id 等值 ∧ revoked_at IS NULL(读的是 revokeAllUserRefreshTokens 的谓词面);id 由 limit 子查询给出,不依赖特定行存在

queries.covers: 历史消息向上翻页 — created_at < cursor 的时间游标 + 倒序取 limit+1 判 hasMore;cursor 用 2100 常量代替,保持 timestamptz 比较语义
queries.sql: SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, tokens, metadata, created_at, reasoning, turn_ordinal FROM chat_messages WHERE conversation_id IN (SELECT conversation_id FROM chat_messages ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AND created_at < '2100-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 21
queries.expect: no error; column count 9. turn_ordinal 同为 2026-09-24 之后新增列

queries.covers: keyset 复合游标 — (created_at < c) OR (created_at = c AND id < uuid) 的两列决胜分页。还原敏感面:对 uuid 常量做字典序比较,要求 uuid 类型的比较运算符在还原库里仍可用
queries.sql: SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, tokens, metadata, created_at, reasoning, turn_ordinal FROM chat_messages WHERE conversation_id IN (SELECT conversation_id FROM chat_messages ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AND (created_at < now() OR (created_at = now() AND id < '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 21

queries.covers: 会话列表消息计数(批量聚合以替代 N+1) — GROUP BY conversation_id + count(id),输入集由 limit 子查询给出
queries.sql: SELECT conversation_id, count(id) AS message_count FROM chat_messages WHERE conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM chat_conversations ORDER BY id LIMIT 20) GROUP BY conversation_id

queries.covers: 本页会话是否被收藏 — user_id 等值 ∧ conversation_id IN(子查询);两个集合同时由 limit 子查询给出,chat_favorites 上 (user_id, conversation_id) 唯一约束的读面

queries.covers: 单条压缩归档完整内容 — messages 是 jsonb **数组根**(被压缩的原始消息列表),应用层再 JSON.parse。还原敏感面:jsonb 里存数组而非对象时内部存储格式仍需可解析。双键 WHERE 是防跨会话越权的原形状
queries.sql: SELECT id, conversation_id, messages, message_count, covered_chars, created_at FROM conversation_message_archives WHERE conversation_id IN (SELECT conversation_id FROM conversation_message_archives ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AND id IN (SELECT id FROM conversation_message_archives ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1

queries.covers: 智能体列表分页 — ORDER BY sort ASC, updated_at DESC + LIMIT/OFFSET;投影展开 agents 全部 35 列,含 4 个 bigint 计数列与 2 个可空 timestamptz
queries.sql: SELECT agent_id, name, description, avatar, cover, category_id, user_id, workspace_id, status, price, is_free, is_vip_exclusive, sort, published_at, created_at, updated_at, remark, agent_version, bot_id, bot_id_str, bot_name, agent_prompt, agent_model, agent_temperature, agent_max_tokens, agent_variables, publish_channel, usage_count, like_count, share_count, collect_count, publish_status, suggested_questions, coze_account_id, user_name FROM agents ORDER BY sort ASC, updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

queries.covers: 智能体关键词搜索的计数侧 — name ILIKE 中文串 ∧ status 等值。还原敏感面:ILIKE 对全角/CJK 的行为依赖 lc_ctype,换集群最先变的就是这一维
queries.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM agents WHERE name ILIKE '%助手%' AND status = 'published'
queries.expect: no error; column count 1; exactly 1 row (aggregate)

queries.covers: 分类列表 — ORDER BY sort ASC, updated_at DESC + LIMIT/OFFSET;agent_categories.status 是 varchar(1) 的 '1'/'0' 约定而非 boolean,写成 = true 会当场报类型错
queries.sql: SELECT category_id, name, description, icon, sort, status, is_paid, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_categories WHERE status = '1' ORDER BY sort ASC, updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0

queries.covers: 近 7 日命中趋势 — GROUP BY date_str(YYYY-MM-DD 的 **text** 列而非 date)+ 字符串区间比较 + COALESCE(SUM(bigint))::int。还原敏感面:排序与区间比较都走 text collation,且 ::int 落回要求 bigint 求和结果仍在 int 域内
queries.sql: SELECT date_str, COALESCE(SUM(hit_count), 0)::int AS hit_count FROM agent_heat_stats WHERE agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM agents ORDER BY agent_id LIMIT 1) AND date_str >= to_char(now() - interval '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY date_str ORDER BY date_str

queries.covers: 中转站模型目录 — ai_model_config_models INNER JOIN ai_model_config ON config_id = id。还原敏感面:两侧都是 bigserial(整型序列主键),且子表带一个 text[] 数组列 tags 与 numeric(18,6) 价格列
queries.sql: SELECT m.id, m.config_id, m.model_id, m.display_name, m.context_length, m.input_price_per_1k, m.output_price_per_1k, m.enabled, m.is_relay_public, m.relay_sort_order, m.points_multiplier, m.tags, c.provider_code, c.name AS config_name, c.enabled AS config_enabled FROM ai_model_config_models m INNER JOIN ai_model_config c ON c.id = m.config_id ORDER BY m.is_relay_public DESC, m.relay_sort_order ASC, m.model_id ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

queries.covers: 上架模型厂商分布 — INNER JOIN 后 GROUP BY 驱动表的 provider_code 并按 count 倒序;与上一条同两个表但聚合根完全不同
queries.sql: SELECT c.provider_code, count(*)::int AS count FROM ai_model_config_models m INNER JOIN ai_model_config c ON c.id = m.config_id WHERE m.is_relay_public = true GROUP BY c.provider_code ORDER BY count(*)::int DESC

queries.covers: 代码库语义检索 — 1 - (embedding <=> query) AS score + ORDER BY embedding <=> query。还原敏感面:pgvector 的 cosine 运算符与 vector(1536) 列类型。查询向量由 array_fill 在库内构造,避免把 1536 个字面量烘进文件(维度必须与列一致,否则报维度不匹配)
queries.sql: SELECT id, file_path, line_start, line_end, language, symbol_name, 1 - (embedding <=> (('[' || array_to_string(array_fill(0.1::double precision, ARRAY[1536]), ',') || ']')::vector)) AS score FROM codebase_chunks WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY embedding <=> (('[' || array_to_string(array_fill(0.1::double precision, ARRAY[1536]), ',') || ']')::vector) LIMIT 20
queries.expect: no error; column count 7. 报 'operator does not exist: <=>;' 或维度不匹配即 vector 扩展未随库还原(CREATE EXTENSION vector 在 0123/0126 等迁移里)

queries.covers: 知识库切片语义检索 — collection_name 等值 ∧ embedding IS NOT NULL 后走同一条 cosine 通道;与上一条不同表、不同附加谓词、不同投影根表
queries.sql: SELECT id, doc_id, content, chunk_index, 1 - (embedding <=> (('[' || array_to_string(array_fill(0.1::double precision, ARRAY[1536]), ',') || ']')::vector)) AS score FROM zhs_knowledge_chunk WHERE collection_name = 'default' AND embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY embedding <=> (('[' || array_to_string(array_fill(0.1::double precision, ARRAY[1536]), ',') || ']')::vector) LIMIT 20
queries.expect: no error; column count 5. 该表同时被 FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY 管辖,见 rls.* 两条

queries.covers: 积分流水分页 — user_id 等值 + created_at 倒序 + LIMIT/OFFSET(ix_point_transactions_user_created_at 服务的正是这个形状,该索引由 2026-09-27 手写迁移补)
queries.sql: SELECT id, user_id, type, source, amount, balance_after, description, reference_id, created_at FROM point_transactions WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

queries.covers: Credits 热力图日聚合 — GROUP BY to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD') + COUNT + COALESCE(SUM(ABS(amount)),0)。还原敏感面:AT TIME ZONE 把 timestamptz 转 timestamp,分桶边界随集群时区设置而变
queries.sql: SELECT to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(amount)), 0) AS points FROM point_transactions WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AND type = 'spend' AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

queries.covers: 积分排行榜 — user_points LEFT JOIN users + 双列倒序(points, experience)。LEFT 侧无对应用户行时必须仍出行,这是它与其它 inner 连接的实质差别
queries.sql: SELECT p.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar, p.points, p.level, p.experience FROM user_points p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id ORDER BY p.points DESC, p.experience DESC LIMIT 100

queries.covers: 智汇值累计口径 — 单条聚合里两个 CASE-WHEN SUM 分支(earned ∈ {0,3,4,5,6} / used = 1)+ ::int 落回。与 wallet 那条的 FILTER(WHERE ...) 是条件求和的两种不同写法,不可互相替代
queries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN op_type IN (0,3,4,5,6) THEN quantity ELSE 0 END)::int, 0) AS total_earned, COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN op_type = 1 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END)::int, 0) AS total_used FROM token_flows WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
queries.expect: no error; column count 2; exactly 1 row

queries.covers: 小程序余额读(裸 SQL)— user_token_balance 主键 user_uuid 是 varchar(64) 而 users.id 是 uuid,比较靠 ::text 转换。还原敏感面:两侧类型不一致时是否仍可比对
queries.sql: SELECT user_uuid, balance, frozen_balance, updated_at FROM user_token_balance WHERE user_uuid = (SELECT id::text FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1

queries.covers: 教育积分当前余额 — 取该成员最新一条流水的 balance(单列投影 + created_at 倒序 limit 1)。该表外键列名是 member_id 而非 user_id
queries.sql: SELECT balance FROM edu_point_records WHERE member_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

queries.covers: 钱包 7 日趋势 — GROUP BY date_trunc('day', created_at) + 三个 FILTER (WHERE op_type = n) 的 SUM 分桶。还原敏感面:date_trunc 结果依赖会话 TimeZone,同一份数据在 UTC 与 Asia/Shanghai 下桶边界不同
queries.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, COALESCE(sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE op_type = 0), 0)::int AS recharge, COALESCE(sum(abs(quantity)) FILTER (WHERE op_type = 1), 0)::int AS withdraw, COALESCE(sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE op_type = 4), 0)::int AS commission FROM token_flows WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY date_trunc('day', created_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('day', created_at)

queries.covers: 支付回调按 order_no 取订单 — 唯一索引等值读;投影展开 orders 全部 24 列(4 个 uuid 外键位、3 个整型金额列、5 个可空 timestamptz)
queries.sql: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, plan_id, amount, currency, status, payment_method, order_type, product_id, target_id, target_title, quantity, original_price, discount_amount, paid_at, cancel_time, refund_time, expires_at, remark, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE order_no = 'restore-drill-probe' LIMIT 1

queries.covers: 营收汇总(分) — coalesce(sum(amount), 0)::int WHERE status = 'paid'。amount 是 integer 分,任何浮点退化或类型回退都会在这条聚合上现形
queries.sql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0)::int AS total FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
queries.expect: no error; column count 1; exactly 1 row

queries.covers: 超时未支付订单扫描 — status = 'pending' ∧ created_at < now() - interval '30 minutes'(应用侧传的是 JS 算好的 Date,常量等价内联)
queries.sql: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, amount, currency, status, order_type, created_at FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' AND created_at < now() - interval '30 minutes'

queries.covers: 资源是否已购 — user_id ∧ product_id ∧ status 三谓词合取的窄投影。product_id 是 varchar **软关联**(无 FK 约束),还原后靠数据而非约束保真
queries.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AND product_id = 'restore-drill-probe' AND status = 'paid' LIMIT 1

queries.covers: 团队成员成交额/佣金/订单数 — 同一 SELECT 里三条相关子查询,分别 SUM(orders.amount) 与 SUM(commission_flows.amount) 并按 outer 行的用户 id 关联。应用侧因 Drizzle 会把 ${users.id} 渲染成裸 id 而必须写显式表限定;这里用不引号化的 users.id 表达同一语义(本文件禁止双引号标识符)（2026-09-27 修正:相关子查询里的外层引用须与 FROM 别名 u 一致 —— 原样 users.id 在 PostgreSQL 报 42P01/invalid reference,生产侧同样跑不通,那意味着这一条对两侧都没有结论）
queries.sql: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.is_vip, coalesce((SELECT sum(o.amount)::int FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.status = 'paid'), 0) AS transaction_volume, coalesce((SELECT sum(cf.amount)::int FROM commission_flows cf WHERE cf.invited_user_id = u.id AND cf.status = 1), 0) AS commission, coalesce((SELECT count(*)::int FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.status = 'paid'), 0) AS order_num FROM users u ORDER BY u.id LIMIT 20
queries.expect: no error; column count 6; rows == users 前 20 行(相关子查询若被错绑到内层表,数值会全为 0 而不报错,这是本条唯一的可判信号)

queries.covers: 开票申请分页 — LEFT JOIN users 取昵称 + amount numeric(10,2) + created_at 倒序 LIMIT/OFFSET;Drizzle 的 select({application: 整表, userNickname: users.nickname}) 形态在此展开为平铺列
queries.sql: SELECT a.id, a.order_id, a.user_id, a.type, a.title, a.tax_no, a.amount, a.status, a.detail, a.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname FROM learn_invoice_applications a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

queries.covers: IM 连接状态卡 — GROUP BY platform + COUNT(*)::int + MAX(created_at)::text。还原敏感面:MAX(timestamptz)::text 的落文本形态随 DateStyle/时区而变
queries.sql: SELECT platform, COUNT(*)::int AS message_count, MAX(created_at)::text AS last_message_at FROM im_messages WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) GROUP BY platform

queries.sql: SELECT id, user_id, platform, enabled, credentials_json, schema_version, created_at, updated_at FROM im_adapters WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) ORDER BY platform LIMIT 32
queries.expect: no error; column count 8. runner 不得打印行值

queries.covers: 站内信会话列表 — 派生表里 row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE... ORDER BY created_at DESC) 取每个对话最近一条,再 LEFT JOIN users 取对方昵称/头像。本文件最复杂的一条:窗口函数 + 派生表 + CASE 选列 + LEFT JOIN 同时压测。CROSS JOIN 的标量子查询代替应用层的 request.userId
queries.sql: SELECT latest.id, latest.sender_id, latest.receiver_id, latest.content, latest.is_read, latest.created_at, latest.other_user_id, u.nickname AS other_nickname, u.avatar AS other_avatar FROM (SELECT m.id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.content, m.is_read, m.created_at, CASE WHEN m.sender_id = me.id THEN m.receiver_id ELSE m.sender_id END AS other_user_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN m.sender_id = me.id THEN m.receiver_id ELSE m.sender_id END ORDER BY m.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM messages m CROSS JOIN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) me WHERE m.sender_id = me.id OR m.receiver_id = me.id) latest LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = latest.other_user_id WHERE latest.rn = 1 ORDER BY latest.created_at DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

queries.covers: 与某人的会话历史 — 双向 (sender,receiver) 的 OR-of-AND 合取 + created_at **正序**分页。两个用户句柄由同表首/尾行给出,不依赖特定行存在
queries.sql: SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read, created_at FROM messages WHERE (sender_id = (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1) AND receiver_id = (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1)) OR (sender_id = (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AND receiver_id = (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

queries.covers: 通知中心分页 — user_id ∧ type 等值 + created_at 倒序 LIMIT/OFFSET;data jsonb 整列读回
queries.sql: SELECT id, user_id, type, title, content, data, is_read, created_at FROM notifications WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AND type = 'system' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

queries.covers: 未读红点数 — COUNT(*) 双谓词;notifications_user_created_idx 第二维支撑的正是这种等值 + 计数
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unread FROM notifications WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AND is_read = false
queries.expect: no error; column count 1; exactly 1 row

queries.covers: 群发前批量取偏好 — WHERE user_id = ANY(ARRAY(...)::uuid[])。还原敏感面:PostgreSQL 数组构造 + uuid[] 显式落型,还原库里 uuid 类型或数组支持缺失会在这一条现形
queries.sql: SELECT user_id, email_enabled, sms_enabled, in_app_enabled, types FROM notification_preferences WHERE user_id = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 5)::uuid[])

queries.covers: 文件搜索 — uploaded_by 等值 OR project_id IN(项目成员子查询),files → project_members → users 两级外键穿透(OR 半边)。files.size 是 bigint
queries.sql: SELECT id, project_id, name, path, size, mime_type, uploaded_by, created_at, deleted_at, deleted_by FROM files WHERE uploaded_by IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) OR project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM project_members WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY created_at DESC

queries.covers: 文件全文搜索 — files.search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery(迁移 0010 建列 + GIN + tsvector_update_trigger)。与 users 那条同为 tsvector 但不同表不同触发器,三者(users/projects/files)任缺其一都说明 0010 未重放
queries.sql: SELECT id, project_id, name, path, size, mime_type FROM files WHERE files.search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery('pg_catalog.simple', 'report') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

queries.covers: 按标签筛文件 — tag_relations.resource_id 是 varchar,子查询里 ::uuid 落型后才与 files.id 可比;同时踩 tag_relations → tags 的外键。还原敏感面:数据形态异常时这里抛 22P02 而非静默空集
queries.sql: SELECT id, project_id, name, size, mime_type, created_at FROM files WHERE id IN (SELECT tag_relations.resource_id::uuid FROM tag_relations WHERE tag_relations.resource_type = 'file' AND tag_relations.tag_id IN (SELECT id FROM tags ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

queries.covers: 白名单规则列表 — (user_id, workspace_path) 复合定位,workspace_path 由主配置表最新一行给出。还原敏感面:text 列参与等值比较,结果随 collation 变
queries.sql: SELECT id, user_id, workspace_path, rule_type, pattern, operation, decision, builtin, created_at FROM workspace_permission_rules WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AND workspace_path IN (SELECT workspace_path FROM workspace_permissions ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) ORDER BY created_at DESC

queries.covers: 用户角色列表 — user_roles INNER JOIN roles(两个 uuid 外键指向两张表)+ 按 user_roles.created_at 升序
queries.sql: SELECT ur.id, ur.user_id, ur.role_id, r.name AS role_name, r.display_name, r.scope, ur.scope_resource_id, ur.created_at FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) ORDER BY ur.created_at

queries.covers: 权限判定链 — user_roles → role_permissions → permissions 三跳 INNER JOIN 后 COUNT。本夹具里唯一的**跨三表外键连接**,四条约束任一条指向缺失主键都会让这一跳变空(而空集是 0 不是报错,所以 expect 明确要求与关联表整体计数一起读)
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AND p.name = 'rbac:manage' LIMIT 1
queries.expect: no error; column count 1; exactly 1 row. c=0 本身不构成还原缺陷(该用户可能确无此权限),但 permissions 整表为空即 RBAC 族未还原

queries.covers: 发布任务列表 — 相关子查询 (SELECT count(*) FROM publish_history WHERE task_id = t.task_id) 取平台数,同时读 targets/results 两个 jsonb 列。publish_tasks.task_id 是业务 UUID **字符串**列而非主键(主键是 bigserial),两表靠字符串关联
queries.sql: SELECT id, task_id, user_id, title, format, status, scheduled_at, started_at, finished_at, targets, results, (SELECT count(*) FROM publish_history WHERE task_id = t.task_id) AS platform_count, error, created_at, updated_at FROM publish_tasks t WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM publish_tasks WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 1) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0

queries.covers: 任务详情内的平台执行历史 — task_id 等值 + created_at **正序**(与下一条同表但不同序、不同投影)
queries.sql: SELECT id, platform, success, published_url, platform_content_id, error_message, duration_ms, created_at FROM publish_history WHERE task_id IN (SELECT task_id FROM publish_tasks ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY created_at ASC

queries.covers: 发布历史列表 — 全表 task_id/platform 可选谓词的读面 + created_at 倒序 LIMIT;success 是 boolean(该表刻意用布尔而非 status 字符串)
queries.sql: SELECT id, task_id, user_id, platform, success, published_url, platform_content_id, error_message, duration_ms, created_at FROM publish_history ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

queries.covers: LLM 调用区间聚合 — JSONB ->> 取 costCents 后 ::numeric 求和、count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='error')、percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP 有序集聚合、::bigint::int 双落差回。一条语句同时压 jsonb 运算符、ordered-set 聚合与 numeric/int 边界
queries.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS call_count, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0)::bigint::int AS total_tokens, coalesce(sum((metadata->>'costCents')::numeric), 0)::int AS total_cost_cents, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'error')::int AS error_count, coalesce(avg(latency_ms), 0)::int AS avg_latency_ms, coalesce(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)::int, 0) AS p95_latency_ms FROM llm_call_logs WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' AND created_at <= now()
queries.expect: no error; column count 6; exactly 1 row

queries.covers: 中转站日趋势 — GROUP BY to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','YYYY-MM-DD')。还原敏感面:命名时区(不是 UTC)要求还原集群的 tz 数据库里真有 Asia/Shanghai,源库与目标库镜像不同时这一条最先失败
queries.sql: SELECT to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, count(*)::int AS call_count, coalesce(sum((metadata->>'costCents')::numeric), 0)::int AS total_cost_cents FROM llm_call_logs WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

queries.covers: PV 排行 — 按 properties->>'path' GROUP BY + count(distinct user_id)。analytics_events.id 是 serial(非默认随机 uuid),与站内多数表的 uuid 主键不同族
queries.sql: SELECT properties->>'path' AS path, count(*)::int AS pv, count(distinct user_id)::int AS unique_users FROM analytics_events WHERE event = 'page_view' AND (properties->>'path') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY properties->>'path' ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 50

queries.covers: 全站 UV — count(distinct coalesce(session_id, ip)) 的回退去重键;两列皆可空,全空时 distinct 退化为 0 而不报错
queries.sql: SELECT count(distinct coalesce(session_id, ip))::int AS uv FROM visit_logs
queries.expect: no error; column count 1; exactly 1 row

queries.covers: 部门树列表 — del_flag 软删 + order_num 排序。sys_dept 是少数用 serial 主键 dept_id + bigint parent_id 的旧架构表(导出名 sysDepts 与表名 sys_dept 单复数不同),users.dept_id 的外键目标就是它
queries.sql: SELECT dept_id, parent_id, ancestors, dept_name, order_num, leader, phone, email, status, del_flag, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_dept WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY order_num ASC

queries.covers: 视频任务分页 — video_generation_tasks.id 是 integer PRIMARY KEY GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,该表由手写迁移 0112 建、不在 drizzle 快照里。还原敏感面:identity 序列的 last_value 未随数据一起还原时,**读不报错但下一次写必撞主键**,所以这里同时给出等值路径
queries.sql: SELECT id, task_id, user_uuid, chat_id, status, message, result, created_at, updated_at FROM video_generation_tasks WHERE id >= 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20 OFFSET 0
queries.expect: no error; column count 9. 另用 pg_sequence_last_value / nextval 单独判序列水位,不在本夹具射程(那是 DML 面)

queries.covers: 按整型 identity 主键取单条视频任务 — id = 常量 ∧ user_uuid 等值(双谓词防越权的原形状)
queries.sql: SELECT id, task_id, user_uuid, status, result, created_at FROM video_generation_tasks WHERE id = 1 AND user_uuid IN (SELECT user_uuid FROM video_generation_tasks ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1

queries.covers: 团队知识空间单行读 — team_knowledge_spaces 带 ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY 与 5 条策略,策略谓词引用 current_setting('app.user_id', true) 并调用 public.team_knowledge_space_visible()。还原敏感面:FORCE 让表属主也受策略约束,策略/支撑函数/角色未随库还原时,这条的表现是**静默 0 行而不是报错**
queries.sql: SELECT id, team_id, name, settings, visibility, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM team_knowledge_spaces WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM team_knowledge_spaces ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1
queries.expect: no error; column count 10. 0 rows 而该表磁盘上有行 ⇒ 策略或支撑函数未还原;报 42883 function does not exist ⇒ 策略函数整批丢失

queries.covers: 团队知识空间列表 — team_id ∧ status='active' + updated_at 倒序 LIMIT;第二张受 FORCE RLS 管辖表的第二条读路径,谓词形态与上一条不同
queries.sql: SELECT id, team_id, name, visibility, status, created_by, updated_at FROM team_knowledge_spaces WHERE team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_knowledge_spaces ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AND status = 'active' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 50

queries.covers: 知识库文档列表(listDocs)— db.select() 全列展开 + owner_uuid ∧ status='active' 双谓词 + created_at 倒序。zhs_knowledge_doc 也在 FORCE RLS 管辖名单内(迁移 20260927100000),而它的 owner_uuid 是 varchar **无外键** 的所有权列;与 zhs_knowledge_chunk 的向量读构成'同族两表各走不同谓词'的对账
queries.sql: SELECT id, owner_uuid, collection_name, title, source_type, source_path, content_hash, chunk_count, status, metadata_json, created_at, updated_at FROM zhs_knowledge_doc WHERE owner_uuid IN (SELECT owner_uuid FROM zhs_knowledge_doc ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC
queries.expect: no error; column count 12; id 是 serial 而非 uuid(与站内多数表不同族)
